        cy, cx = center_of_mass(grid, labeled, i)
        
        objects.append({
            'color': color,
            'pattern': pattern,
            'cy': cy,
            'cx': cx,
            'min_r': min_r, 'min_c': min_c,

    def normalize_pattern(obj):
